methodologyNotes: Adversarial re-verification (2026-06-15/18): every official pricing page was re-fetched with WebFetch — cookiebot.com/en/pricing/, cookieyes.com/pricing/, termly.io/pricing/, osano.com/plans/cookie-consent, iubenda.com/en/pricing, enzuzo.com/pricing, complianz.io/pricing/, secureprivacy.ai/pricing, didomi.io/offers, usercentrics.com/pricing/. All 10 vendors are real with live pricing pages; 0 removed. Prices were confirmed exactly against each page. Cookiebot and Usercentrics publish paid tiers in EUR only (USD is a currency-selector option, no fixed USD figures), so monthlyUsd is null for those paid tiers rather than a guessed conversion. iubenda publishes both EUR and USD, so its USD figures are used as published. Quote-only/enterprise tiers (Didomi all CMP, Osano Basic Privacy, Enzuzo Enterprise, Secure Privacy Enterprise, Termly Agency, Usercentrics Corporate) have monthlyUsd=null. Compliance (SOC 2 Type 2 + HIPAA for Cookiebot/Usercentrics; SOC 2 for CookieYes) verified against the live Usercentrics press release of 2025-08-18 and the CookieYes trust center; all other vendors lack public HIPAA/SOC 2 claims and are null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
